author: GamingBolt
description:
Madden  NFL 27 does many things differently even as it retains some of Madden 26’s best features. Indeed, it builds on the previous game to extend what worked, improving player control over key areas while making those options more intuitive and seamless to the action. 

That’s ambitious and potentially risky, as the new additions must integrate well enough to justify their inclusion. However, if the past few years are any indication, things might just work out well for this one. We’re taking a look at how it's switching things up compared to last year, and we're delighted to have you along for the ride. Hop on and let’s look at what’s changing, and why that matters in Madden 27.
title: Madden NFL 27 vs Madden NFL 26: 10 BIGGEST Gameplay Changes

author: GamingBolt
description:
Say what you will about Rockstar Games and really anything regarding Grand Theft Auto 6 – it knows how to drop some bombshell news when fans least expect it. Fresh off announcing the price in June for perhaps its most anticipated game since...well, its last most anticipated game, the official Twitter has confirmed when we can expect the next big reveal: August 27th. 

Right smack in the middle of Gamescom. Cue cheers, confetti, celebrations, tears. It's not enough that pre-orders are tracking strongly or that Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick constantly reassures us that it's coming this year. Each reveal makes it feel that much more real – that much more potent, even if I won't truly believe it until it's in my hands. Well, in my digital library because there's no physical disc, but you get what I mean.
title: GTA 6's First Major Reveal Is Coming, And It Could CHANGE EVERYTHING

author: GamingBolt
description:
For all those who inexplicably wake up, drenched in sweat, screaming "Game over, man! Game over!", there's fantastic (or foreboding) news. Aliens: Fireteam Elite 2 is out on August 25th for Xbox Series X/S, PS5, and PC, bringing the tense co-op shooting and terrifying hallway crawls back about five years after the original. 

Aside from 15 new missions, significant weapon changes, and cross-platform voice chat at launch, there is a lot to look forward to. Let's start with a rather troubling revelation.
title: Aliens: Fireteam Elite 2 - 15 NEW Things You Should Know Before You Buy
